contentSections.heading: Frequently asked Questions
contentSections.text: Frequently asked Questions 1. What is Posture Perfect Pocket Spring Orthopedic Mattress? Posture Perfect is a premium medium firm hybrid orthopedic mattress featuring 3-zone pocket springs, 5-zone dual density orthopedic support, and Heat Away™ technology. It has a Euro top finish with memory foam quilting, zero motion transfer technology, and uses 40% recycled yarn in its eco-friendly fabric. It’s part of Duroflex’s Duropedic range, which is doctor-recommended for targeted support and exclusively approved by the National Health Academy. 2. What problem does Posture Perfect Pocket Spring Orthopedic Mattress solve? It addresses multiple sleep concerns: back pain and poor posture -- through 5-zone certified orthopedic support, partner disturbance with zero motion transfer technology, heat buildup during night sweats using Heat Away™ technology, and pressure point discomfort. The combination of pocket springs and memory foam solves the choice between bounce and support. 3. Who is the Posture Perfect Pocket Spring Orthopedic Mattress best for? Ideal for desk job professionals with extended sitting hours, back/neck pain sufferers, sleepers prone to night sweat and anyone seeking doctor-recommended orthopedic support with luxury comfort. It is also suitable for those looking for a supportive spring mattress. 4. How does Posture Perfect Pocket Spring Orthopedic Mattress work? Multi-layered hybrid construction delivers targeted support: Euro top padding provides plush comfort on contact; memory foam quilting contours to your body. The 5-Zone Support System keeps your spine straight and reduces pressure on sore spots like your neck, back, shoulders, and hips. 3-zone individually wrapped pocket springs provide responsive support with zero motion transfer; Heat Away™ technology helps release body heat, keeping your mattress cool and comfortable all night long. 5. How is Posture Perfect Pocket Spring Orthopedic Mattress different from alternatives? Unlike basic spring mattresses, the 5-zone dual density layer is exclusive to Duroflex, providing region-specific spinal alignment. The Heat Away™ technology outperforms standard cooling methods. Euro top construction with memory foam quilting adds luxury comfort. 6. How does Posture Perfect Pocket Spring Orthopedic Mattress feel? Firmness: Medium -- Combines plush surface comfort with responsive support. The Euro top feels luxurious and soft, while the dual-density orthopedic layer prevents excessive sinking and maintains spinal alignment. 7. Does the Posture Perfect Pocket Spring Orthopedic Mattress come with a warranty? Yes, the mattress comes with a 10 year conditional warranty and 10 day replacement policy. 8. How to care for Posture Perfect Pocket Spring Orthopedic Mattress? Always use a mattress protector to protect against dust, spills, and allergens, and get it professionally deep-cleaned twice a year for better hygiene. Do not flip or turn the mattress, avoid ironing on it, and never fold or bend it as it may damage the mattress structure.
